{{Top}}
The '''Fode and Beed Show''' was a weekly show performed by [[Fodesinbeed Annodue/Legends|Fodesinbeed Annodue]], a two-headed [[Podracing/Legends|podrace]] commentator, in the last decades of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].<ref name="NEGD">''[[The New Essential Guide to Droids]]''</ref> The show enjoyed popularity on [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] and was regularly broadcast at the [[podracers' hovel]].<ref name="AS">''[[Star Wars: Anakin's Speedway]]''</ref>
